content.text:
Two Acme devices are low on disk space: a ThinkPad X1 Carbon with 2.6% free and a MacBook Pro with 2.0% free. Both are rated critical [disk_low/8NM23J95R5I6, disk_low/MT7PJB7N5LRE].

**Evidence**
- **8NM23J95R5I6**: ThinkPad X1 Carbon running Windows 10 22H2, owned by emp-acme-1005. It has 26.5 GB free out of 1024 GB, which is 2.6% [disk_low/8NM23J95R5I6, 8NM23J95R5I6/2026-06-12].
- **MT7PJB7N5LRE**: MacBook Pro running macOS 14.5, owned by emp-acme-1003. It has 10.2 GB free out of 512 GB, which is 2.0% [disk_low/MT7PJB7N5LRE, MT7PJB7N5LRE/2026-06-12].
- I checked the latest snapshot of all 10 devices, and only these 2 are below the threshold [8NM23J95R5I6/2026-06-12, MT7PJB7N5LRE/2026-06-12]. Two separate checks (a device filter and the low-disk detector) found the same two devices.

**Other issues on these two devices** (for context)
- Both devices are failing the screen_lock and os_up_to_date checks, both at medium severity [8NM23J95R5I6/2026-06-12, MT7PJB7N5LRE/2026-06-12].
- The ThinkPad's battery shows "Service Recommended" with 1157 cycles [8NM23J95R5I6/2026-06-12].

**Caveats**
- "Low on disk" follows the policy: less than 10% of the disk free (`disk_low_free_pct: 10`).
- This is based on the latest snapshot only. I didn't check how fast disk space is dropping on other devices, so devices that are close to the threshold aren't listed here.
- I haven't proposed any actions, as planned. If you'd like, I can propose a disk cleanup for both devices.
